method: Case-insensitive high-signal regex triage from the skillspector-review workflow
scope: The exact checked-out repository's skills/ directory
interpretation: This narrow regex pass is a lead generator, not a security clearance.
manual_review_required: encoded, obfuscated, Unicode, invisible-text, HTML/Markdown, typoglycemia, or multimodal instructions
system-prompt extraction, exfiltration, forged observations, or tool-parameter manipulation
untrusted model output flowing into commands, writes, HTML/SVG, package managers, network calls, or privileged tools
